jython:import re
import re\nvalues = [re.sub(r'[_-.]', '', value) for value in values]\nflight_durations = [datetime.strptime(value + ' A.M.', '%H:%M %I %p') - datetime.strptime('9:00 A.M.', '%H:%M %I %p') for value in values]\navg_duration = sum(flight_durations) / len(flight_durations)\nreturn avg_duration

This expression first removes unnecessary spaces, hyphens, and periods from the sched_dep_time column using a list comprehension. Then it converts the cleaned strings into datetime objects, calculates the difference between each scheduled time and a reference time (9:00 A.M.), and finally computes the average flight duration by dividing the total duration by the number of flights.
